name: harborline-sigma-plugins
description: Harborline Outfitters Sigma plugins: Number check (/) and Spring cockpit (/cockpit/), plus a test bench (/bench.html).

scripts.build:bench: vite build --mode preview && node scripts/embed-plugin.mjs && vite build --mode bench
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:bench && vite build && node scripts/add-bench.mjs
scripts.data: python3 scripts/gen_sample_data.py && python3 scripts/gen_cockpit_data.py && python3 scripts/build_sql.py
